title: Curriculum proof repair with learned counterexamples
abstract: arXiv:2611.13627v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language models (LMs) have substantially lowered the barrier to applying formal verification for building reliable and secure software. Existing approaches commonly follow the verifier-in-the-loop paradigm, but the verifier often provides only coarse, binary pass/fail feedback, which offers little actionable signal on how the proof should be repaired. Recent work shows that counterexamples provide more actionable feedback by grounding proof failures in concrete program states, but generating useful ones at inference time requires costly iterative refinement. We present TopoVerus, an LM-based framework for Verus proof repair that internalizes counterexample-guided diagnosis as a model capability, producing useful counterexamples in a single pass. translated_title: 基于学习反例的课程式证明修复
translated_abstract: 语言模型已经大幅降低了应用形式化验证来构建可靠且安全软件的门槛。现有方法通常遵循“验证器在环”范式，但验证器往往只提供粗糙的、二元的通过/失败反馈，对于应当如何修复证明几乎不提供可操作的信号。近期研究表明，反例通过将证明失败锚定在具体的程序状态上，能够提供更具可操作性的反馈，但在推理时生成有用的反例需要代价高昂的迭代细化。我们提出了TopoVerus，一个基于语言模型的Verus证明修复框架，它将反例引导的诊断内化为模型自身的能力，从而一次性生成有用的反例。我们的核心洞察是，将反例生成不作为独立的验证任务来训练，而是作为数据驱动的诊断目标：当一个反例在其条件下有助于……（原文摘要至此处被截断）
tldr: 提出TopoVerus框架，将反例引导的证明诊断内化为语言模型的自身能力，通过数据驱动的课程式训练使模型能够一次性生成有用的反例，从而高效修复Verus形式化证明。
en_tdlr: TopoVerus is an LM-based Verus proof repair framework that internalizes counterexample-guided diagnosis as a model capability via data-driven curriculum training, enabling one-pass generation of useful counterexamples.
